query:
SELECT 
  u.email, u.name, u.maxActions, u.actionsLeft, u.createdAt,
  t.type, t.amount, t.balance, t.reason, t.createdAt as tokenDate
FROM app_users u
LEFT JOIN token_transactions t ON t.userId = u.id
WHERE u.email LIKE '%8822705%'
ORDER BY t.createdAt ASC;
